mountain: Mountain. Blocks movement and pushes. Breaks after 2 hits.
water: Water. Ground units pushed in drown. Flyers are safe.
chasm: Chasm. Non-flying units pushed in fall to their death.
forest: Forest. Catches fire when hit; burning units take 1 damage per turn.
building: Building. Each hit costs 1 grid power (15% chance to resist).
objective: Objective building. Protect it for a bonus. Hits also cost grid power.
burning: On fire: any unit here catches fire.
spawn: Spawn point: an enemy emerges here after the enemy attacks. A unit standing on it blocks it and takes 1 damage.
